Agent Name: Tizin_Translation_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: They misapplied the verb’s argument structure. For Maktay (“is pleasing to”), the experiencer (“I”) should be the direct object (accusative “Mato”) and the liked item (“apples”) should be the subject (nominative “Apple”), yielding V-DO-S as “Maktay Mato Apple.” Instead, they used “Zapple” (accusative) for apples and “Pa” (nominative) for I, producing “Maktay Zapple Pa,” which inverts the required roles.
